craft_notes: Sthāyin: pride confessing itself. Device: end-dash→comma (musing stated softly, vaunt questioned). Vṛtti shine-forth kept in L0 grounds. Rejected: 'I shine' for 'I am thine-made' — killed: gloss-talk smuggled into song; song keeps image, grounds keep doctrine. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: 'Why this vaunt?' — mused in heart, O Sovereign Height,
'vaunting, I am thine-made' — ah me, unselfed: what glee?
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ smayeneti matvāpi manasā parameśvara smayena tvanmayo 'smīti māmi nātmani kiṃ mudā

reads_against.argmap: 'What with pride?' having even thought with mind, O Supreme Lord.; 'With pride I am made-of-you' — me(?) not in self — what with joy? → Thinking pride, claiming made-of-you, yet not in self — what joy?
c1_essence: Pride claiming made-of-you yet not in self; rest in mind-bliss after weighing duties.
reads_against.l2: Thinking in mind, 'why this pride?', O highest Lord — 'proud, I am made of you' — ah me, not in myself: what joy is this?
